name: Honma Golf Limited
summary: Honma Golf Limited, an investment holding company, designs, develops, manufactures, and sells a range of golf related products in Japan, Korea, Hong Kong, Macau, rest of China, North America, Europe, and internationally. The company offers sets, fairways, hybrids, irons, wedges, putters, drivers, and accessories, such as golf balls, caddie bags, club covers, golf gloves and shoes, and other accessories. It also offers apparel for men and women under the BERES, TOUR WORLD, Be ZEAL, and HONMA brands.
